text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of the Senior Year summer training camp.
A bus bound for the academy was parked in front of the lodge.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. So this marks the end of summer training camp.
Still, I believe we gave it everything we had.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer. You look a bit sleepy too.
You should get plenty of rest on the bus ride back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... I was planning to take a break next to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Biwa Hayahide boarded the bus as well.
As I stepped forward to follow her—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Did you see that? Narita Brian's
training during summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I saw it. What on earth was
that ungodly speed?"

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
And to think she worked her way up that far, yet she's still saying "it's not enough"...
...Just how high can she go?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She truly is a "monster."
Another half a year, and it'll be the Arima Kinen, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Narita Brian's shadow was already looming
right around the corner.
